The government has been restructured to include two branches. The first and primary of which is an elected congress of representatives from the various provinces (of which there are 12) and city states (of which there are now 4) in the nation, from which a Prime Minister is elected. The Libertarian Socialist Party has won 65% majority representation in this new congress, with the Communist Party winning 27%, and the Qing Dynastic Party holding the remaining 8%. The new Prime Minister is representative of the Libertarian Socialist Party, 李麦克 (Li Maike).

The new administrative divisions of the PRSC are as follows:

Municipalities: Chongqing (Capital), Pearl River Delta (Composed of the 9 cities around the Pearl River Delta formerly part of Guangdong), Hong Kong, and Macau

Provinces: Sichuan, Hunan, Hubei, Zhejiang, Guangxi, Yunnan, Jiangxi, Guangdong (whose capital has moved to Zhanjiang), Fujian, Guizhou, Hainan, and Tibet

The second branch is a newly reformed supreme court that will handle the legality of the congress' decisions based on the new constitution which was signed earlier this week guaranteeing a full spectrum of civil rights based on the principles of personal liberty above government control and Confucius' idea of "Do not do to others what you do not want done to yourself."

The new government has taken a relatively hands off libertarian approach towards this new nation. The economic means of production are to be collectively owned and operated by the people. The government itself will be responsible solely for infrastructure, foreign relations, defense, legal disputes, etc. The people owning and operating the industrial and service industries within the nation.
